text:
Rafael Silva: Heads-up 1: Candidate Beatriz Alves (Frontend SWE) is in BRT (SE3o Paulo). She asked for interview times that avoid evenings due to childcare (no interviews after 17:00 BRT). Also prefers in-person pickup at our SP distribution center rather than home delivery.
Maya (Recruiter): Confirmed preference. Candidate available Mon/Wed mornings BRT. She also asked whether travel reimbursement is available if she chooses to come onsite for future loops.
Ellen: Policy: we can reimburse local travel for interviews up to BRL 200 and provide taxi voucher for safety. Need receipts and completed expense form. Maya, please pre-send reimbursement form link and note in invite.
Sam: For the pickup, SP distribution center requires a signed LOA + photo ID and a pickup code. We need 48h notice to schedule front-desk hold.
Maya (Recruiter): LOA sent and signed today. Candidate prefers Mon morning next week. I'll collect ID and send distribution center contact.
Luis: Scheduling note: BRT (UTC-3) vs PST (UTC-8) = 5h difference. If candidate can't do after 17:00 BRT, panel must finish by 17:00 which is noon PST. Panel prefers afternoon PST; volunteers?
Rafael Silva: Can we do two shorter sync interviews during candidate morning (09:00 BRT) plus a recorded take-home for one interviewer? That keeps panel in comfortable PST times.
Ellen: Yes, agree. Also add safety note: if candidate comes onsite, provide a short onsite welcome packet and childcare-friendly room details (quiet room for nursing/feeding). HR requires we note this in the calendar event.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: distribution center pickups require 48h lead time and signed LOA. Expense policy: https://redwood/internal/expense-guidelines (auto-fill available).
Sam: Distribution center replied: pickup approved. Use subject "Redwood pickup - Beatriz Alves - Code BR-SP-5590". Bring photo ID & signed LOA. Pickup window: Mon 2027-02-08 09:00-10:00 BRT.
Maya (Recruiter): Proposed interview slot: Mon 2027-02-08 09:30 BRT (panel: 09:30-10:30 BRT, two 30m interviews). Adding reimbursement form, pickup code, LOA, and childcare notes to invite.
Luis: Panel volunteers confirmed: Rafael (09:30-10:00), Sam (10:00-10:30), recorded design take-home assigned to Ellen.
Ellen: I'll draft the recorded take-home prompt and upload to the candidate packet. Also will include clear submission instructions (deadline 48h).
Maya (Recruiter): Candidate responded: "Thanks, 09:30 works and I appreciate the childcare note. I'll pick up the device at SP center at 09:00." :white_check_mark:
Rafael Silva: I'll submit a loaner request now. PeopleOps Bot: please remind the team of 48h shipping/pickup window.
PeopleOps Bot: Loaner request received. Ticket LOANER-2027-133 created. Pickup code BR-SP-5590. Reminder: bring signed LOA & ID to pickup.
Sam: I'll attach taxi voucher instructions and expense form link in the invite. Also adding optional childcare accommodation line: "If you need a private space during interview day, reply here and HR will arrange."
Maya (Recruiter): Invite sent to candidate & panel with checklist: `-- LOA signed -- ID for pickup -- test VPN 15m prior -- pickup at 09:00 BRT -- reimbursement form attached`
Luis: All set. Post-interview: collect receipt and candidate experience note. Thanks team :thumbsup:
